_readme: Canonical section-header and bold-label wording for non-English Child generation (ADR-0135). Keys are the exact English template labels in the Make.com Child blueprint. Spanish/German/French/Italian/Portuguese values start from the most common wording already delivered to customers where it was a real translation (French and Portuguese often shipped English labels instead), the rest and Dutch were written for this pack and have NOT had native-speaker review. Header voice addresses the player (es tu, de du, fr vous, it tu, pt voce, nl jouw). Danish and Swedish were added 2026-10-12 (ADR-0152): Danish follows the wording most used in the Danish package "Champagnens Skygge", both have NOT had native-speaker review. Edit here, then run scripts/build-label-tables.mjs and rebuild the Child (temp-files/build-child-v62.py). European Portuguese (Portugal) was added 2026-10-17 (ADR-0170): informal tu, ronda, guião, ficheiro, partilha; the Brazilian table keeps the key 'Portuguese'; neither has had native-speaker review for the European wording.
